chapters.reason: Bayesian Flow Networks operate on continuous probability simplex representations and use iterative denoising/refinement, aligning closely with embedding-based diffusion paradigms.
The paper explicitly addresses discrete data modeling and compares its performance against discrete diffusion models, which are a core focus of masked diffusion research.

The generative procedure and the ability to perform language modeling suggest a hybrid approach to sequence generation that bridges diffusion-like refinement with autoregressive-like discrete data handling.
